{{Quote|The Chancellor is not a bad man, Obi-Wan.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], speaking of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Supreme Chancellor''' was the title of the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] and Government as well as [[President of the Senate|Senate President]] and [[Chair of the Senate/Legends|Senate Chair]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The title '''President of the Republic''' was sometimes used in place of Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> '''The Office of the Supreme Chancellor''' was the central name for the advisors who were important for the Chancellor, such as the ''Vice Chair'' and the ''financial advisors, ''although the "office" existed it was not very powerful.

==Appointment of the Chancellor==
A Supreme Chancellor was elected by and from the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|representatives]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for four year terms. The chancellor could be removed from office at any time by the Senate with a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]]. All of the Chancellors elected between [[1400 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] were Jedi, a trend finally broken with the 1000 BBY election of [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]].<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

==Powers and functions of the Chancellorship==
{{Quote|The Chancellor has little real power.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Janarus-TOR.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Dorian Janarus]], Supreme Chancellor from c. 3653—3641 BBY]]
The Supreme Chancellor was largely a powerless position in the last years of the Galactic Republic,<ref name="TPM" /> especially after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], however with the power vested as [[President of the Senate]], a chancellor held some authority of bureaucratic procedures in the Senate, such as to call an [[Special session of Congress/Legends|special session of Congress]]. However, a chancellor could invoke a prerogative in circumventing minor aspects of the Senate's procedure and held absolute control of the Right of Speech within the Senate, in extreme cases having the right to banish a senator. The Chancellor also served as the head of the [[Senatorial Council]].

It was still a very prestigious position, however, and the Chancellor had a grand office in both the Senate Rotunda's Chancellory and in the dome-like Senate Office Building in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. The Chancellor was properly addressed as "Your Excellency". The symbol of the office of the Chancellor, as well as the Galactic Senate as a whole, was a fanned spear. This sigil was also emblazoned prominently on the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's podium]] in the center of the Senate Rotunda's Main Chamber. When in the Main Chamber, the Chancellor usually wore a [[Veda cloth/Legends|Veda cloth]] robe. They were outwardly identified by a azure blue sash around the waist in the case of humanoids, the same color as the Senate Guards, called the "Blue Band of Chancery," and thus, this particular color was forbidden to be worn by anyone else. Any Senator who still chose to add blue to parts of their wardrobe, such as Senator Palpatine choosing a blue collar, was thus declaring their interest in becoming chancellor themselves.<ref name="TPM VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The Chancellor was elected from among the Senators who made up the Galactic Senate and served a term of office that lasted for four standard years. A Chancellor could legally serve only two consecutive four-year terms before he or she had to step down due to term limits.

[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was Supreme Chancellor during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and presided over the dispute between [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]'s [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]'s Senator, [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], over if there was proof that the Trade Federation invaded Naboo. He was ousted when Amidala, on Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] urging, moved for a Vote of No Confidence.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:ChancellorPalpatine-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the last Supreme Chancellor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]]]

The office became much more powerful during the term of Chancellor Palpatine, who was able to convince the Senate to grant him a range of "emergency" powers due to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and then the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], including an unconstitutional extension of his term of office after [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] for the duration of the Separatist Crisis and authority as [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] of their [[Republic Military/Legends|new military]] during the Clone Wars. The Chancellor was given more direct power over administrative concerns, and he was allowed to overrule local planetary and sectorial governments. The [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] allowed him to appoint military governors to every planet in the Republic, and the [[Security Act amendment]] gave him complete control over the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Order]] and Republic military, stripping both the Jedi and the Senate of their previous oversight.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|proclaimed]] the transformation of the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], thus becoming a dictator and replacing the office of Supreme Chancellor with that of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="ROTS" /> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] did not revive the title, instead choosing to call its Head of State and Government the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]].<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

==Style of office==
The Chancellor of the Republic used the style of "Your Excellency" (this was in contrast to the style of "Your Imperial Majesty" used during the later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]), for example when conversing with [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] officers such as Admiral [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]].<ref name="RoJMC">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|name=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''|date=2013-01-15|archivefile=File:Memo.jpg}}</ref> When in the senate, the Chancellor traditionally referred to him/herself in the third person as "The Chair"/"The Chair(wo)man"<ref name="TPM" /> to highlight their position as ''primus/a inter pares'' (first among equals); however, Palpatine notably never used this style of speech.

==Behind the scenes==
The leader of the Republic had previously been styled President of the Republic in [[1976]]'s [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], although this may also have simply been one of the Chancellor's many titles. There is further confusion in that [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' describe the [[Sidrona|Republic's leader]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] as the [[President of the Senate]] while [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]'s [[Databank (original)|databank]] entry described the same character as the Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|ulicqeldroma|Qel-Droma, Ulic}}</ref> In addition, in ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'', Palpatine was mentioned to be the President of the Galactic Senate, although ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'' updated it to being the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Senate.
